title: Bluffton & Buchanan Lake Loop
summary: A loop from Liberty Hill through Burnet and Buchanan Dam to Bluffton, with a stop at Bluffton Store.
body_markdown:
I start at the US 183 and TX 29 crossing in Liberty Hill and head west through Burnet and Buchanan Dam, then turn toward Bluffton. Bluffton Store is a nice place to stop, buy some water, and take a few photos. Maybe grab some snacks before getting back on the road.

From there, I follow Ranch Road 2241 west to TX 29 and ride back to Liberty Hill. It’s about 107 miles altogether, starting and finishing at the same place.

sources.title: Google Maps itinerary supplied by the rider

stops.note: Stop for water, snacks, and photos.

author_note.text: I like the views, the ranches, and the open spaces. A relaxed ride that suits me.
